scope: Operation-neutral durable projection after a qualified Opening; no Opening acquisition or provider call.

transition.input: qualified Opening with stable operation_id, mint, opening timestamp, and universal adoption identity
transition.idempotence: completion_id primary key and unique stable coordinates

durable_fact.financial_semantics: Copy already-qualified retained price facts only; do not recompute. Missing values remain null. A retained running peak is scoped peak, not lifetime ATH.

projection.live: qualified MONITORING_ACTIVE universal token with no completion fact
projection.history: completion fact exists; it wins exclusively over LIVE
projection.failed_or_missing_opening: durable universal_monitor_nonlive_projection OPENING_PENDING or RIGHT_CENSORED row; never LIVE
projection.current_mc: LIVE-only and excluded from completion fact
projection.scheduler: all future lifecycle work is terminal/ineligible; evidence is retained
